issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing internal_calc as a private (non-global) helper function, but the solution exports internal_calc as a global symbol. This contradicts the specified visibility and may confuse students about whether the helper should be accessible externally.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the specification by removing the 'global internal_calc' declaration so internal_calc remains a private (non-exported) label. Alternatively, if exporting the helper was intended, update the problem statement to allow internal_calc to be global.
